nodes.description: address private owner; privileged access-control anchor used by delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress
public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf in UniswapExchange; mutated without SafeMath
public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance in UniswapExchange
public totalSupply; fixed at construction, additionally trackable by ERC20 mint/burn
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter compared against _saleNum
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist flag that bypasses ensure/condition restrictions
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount enforced in condition
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount enforced in condition
uint256 private _saleNum; maximum number of sales per address in condition
address tradeAddress; mutable whitelisted address respected by ensure
address constant UNI router 0x7a250d...488D; hardcoded bypass address in ensure
public payable delegate(address a, bytes b) that performs a.delegatecall(b) after an owner check
public payable transferFrom(_from,_to,_value) that mutates allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum without SafeMath
public payable transfer(_to,_value) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
public payable approve(_spender,_value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
internal view ensure(_from,_to,_value) implementing an owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale whitelist or condition fallback
internal view condition(_from,_value) enforcing _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale limits
public init(saleNum,token,maxToken) owner-only setter of _saleNum,_minSale,_maxSale
public payable owner-only batch transfer using unchecked multiply and balance arithmetic
public owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist slot
internal pure pairFor computing a Uniswap pair address from factory/tokenA/tokenB and init code hash
payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and the UNI router allowance
internal _transfer of ERC20 using SafeMath for balance updates
internal _mint of ERC20 increasing _totalSupply and balances
internal _burn of ERC20 decreasing balance and _totalSupply
internal _approve of ERC20 writing the _allowances mapping
public ERC20 transfer calling _transfer with _msgSender()
public ERC20 transferFrom calling _transfer and _approve with SafeMath allowance subtraction
public ERC20 approve calling _approve with _msgSender()
msg.sender: external caller used for owner checks, allowance ownership and _msgSender()
a.delegatecall(b) with arbitrary target and calldata, executes foreign code in this storage context
address(token).call(data) in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn, an arbitrary external call
UniswapExchange balance/allowance arithmetic performed with native +,-,* instead of SafeMath
private callOptionalReturn performing a low-level call to a token and decoding its boolean result
_from address parameter of UniswapExchange.transferFrom
_to address parameter of UniswapExchange.transferFrom/transfer
_value amount parameter of UniswapExchange.transferFrom/transfer
_tos recipient array parameter of batchSend
total = _value * _tos.length local computed in batchSend without overflow checks
a delegatecall target address parameter of delegate
b delegatecall calldata parameter of delegate
addr parameter written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress
saleNum parameter of init assigned to _saleNum
token parameter of init assigned to _minSale
maxToken parameter of init assigned to _maxSale
_supply parameter of the UniswapExchange constructor scaled into totalSupply
_name string parameter of the constructor
_symbol string parameter of the constructor

edges.reason: delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before reaching the privileged delegatecall
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b) on arbitrary target and calldata in this storage context
owner is compared against msg.sender inside delegate()
caller-supplied target a is used as the delegatecall destination
caller-supplied bytes b is forwarded as delegatecall payload
transfer(_to,_value) forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving balances
_from parameter is used for allowance, balance and ensure checks in transferFrom
_to parameter is used for ensure and balance credit in transferFrom
_value is subtracted from allowance and balanceOf without SafeMath
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] using native arithmetic
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from]
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are unchecked operations
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from to decide whether an allowance is consumed
ensure falls back to condition(_from,_value) when the address is not whitelisted
ensure returns true when _from or _to equals owner, bypassing all sale conditions
ensure returns true when canSale[_from] is set, bypassing condition restrictions
ensure returns true when _from is the mutable tradeAddress whitelist slot
ensure returns true when _from is the hardcoded UNI router constant
ensure computes the pair address through pairFor before the whitelist comparison
condition reads _saleNum
condition reads _minSale
condition reads _maxSale
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key
init requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale parameters
init assigns _minSale
init assigns _maxSale
init assigns _saleNum
saleNum parameter becomes _saleNum
token parameter scales into _minSale
maxToken parameter scales into _maxSale
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner
batchSend debits and credits balanceOf entries without overflow protection
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and balance arithmetic in a loop
_tos length multiplies _value to form total, an unchecked overflow vector
local total = _value * _tos.length drives the balance subtraction
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner
setTradeAddress overwrites the tradeAddress whitelist slot
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress
constructor sets owner = msg.sender
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply
_supply parameter is scaled into totalSupply
_name parameter is stored as the token name
_symbol parameter is stored as the token symbol
callOptionalReturn issues a low-level call to the token address with user-influenced data
ERC20 transfer calls _transfer
ERC20 transferFrom calls _transfer
ERC20 transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance
ERC20 approve calls _approve
ERC20 transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender
ERC20 approve uses _msgSender() as the owner
_mint increases _totalSupply
_burn decreases _totalSupply

normalization_plan.reason: _from only exists as an argument of transferFrom and is fully consumed by its allowance/balance checks
_to is a transient recipient argument that has no standalone semantic identity
_value is a transient amount argument driving the unchecked balance arithmetic
_tos is only meaningful inside batchSend where its length scales the transferred total
total is a temporary computed value in batchSend and has no independent role
a is the delegatecall target argument and is only used by delegate
b is the delegatecall payload argument and is only used by delegate
addr is written straight into tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress
saleNum is directly assigned to _saleNum by init
token is scaled and assigned to _minSale by init
maxToken is scaled and assigned to _maxSale by init
_supply is consumed at construction to mint totalSupply
_name is only used to set the name state variable at construction
_symbol is only used to set the symbol state variable at construction
